about_the_game:
For those who are ready for intense battles on any battlefield, the Winner's Arsenal pack will become a reliable ally in PvP battles. Restore your health, boost your attack, block enemy curses and instantly return to battle—all to turn the tide of battle in your favor.

Contains:

·    Blood Resonator (×10)
Gives +5 Stamina and restores health in the amount of 5% from damage dealt. The effect lasts for 60 minutes.

·    Vial of Blood (×10)
Increases the amount of Blood Tokens you receive on the Battleground by 50%.

·    Purification Potion (×20)
Cleanses from negative effects and protects against them for 10 seconds.

·    Thirum's Nectar (×50)
Instantly restores 100% of health, energy and mana. Cooldown: 30 seconds, unaffected by other items.

·    Ademar's Elixir of Superpower (×50)
Gives +50 to Attack and +25% to Defense for 15 minutes. The effect is not dispelled upon death.

All items are linked to the account and cannot be transferred or sold. After purchase, this DLC will appear in your Golden Chest on the character selection screen.
